thread:
nora: quick alert  
 noticed a steady trickle of quota "bleed" where project A shows extra requests while project B drops. seems correlated with sidecar rate-limiter bucket affinity when requests are muxed by the edge.
daniel: can you describe the path? is it the service-mesh sidecar or the gateway doing the multiplexing?
jess: from traces it looks like the envoy sidecar collapses multiple upstream requests into a single connection and the rate-limiter assigns a bucket based on the first request's `x-project-id` header. later requests on same connection inherit that bucket in metrics.
 yusuf: that would cause attribution to stick to the first-seen project for the duration of the bucket window. we're effectively leaking quota from subsequent projects to the first.
nora: exactly. i dug into logs: `sidecar: conn=1234 first_project=proj-alpha bucket=rl_42 ttl=60s; later: proj-beta request received -> attributed bucket=rl_42 -> counts to proj-alpha`.
daniel: tough one. two orthogonal fixes: (A) make the rate-limiter bucket key include `connection_id + project_id` so affinity is per-project, (B) push attribution upstream and tag each request at ingress with `effective_project` before any sidecar multiplexing.
jess: preference for pushing `effective_project` at ingress. lower cardinality change: add `attribution_source` label to `api_requests_total` with values `token`, `header`, `ingress-tag` and an `effective_project` label for telemetry. we can enable that behind a flag to limit cardinality.
 yusuf: agreed. telemetry-first approach: (1) emit new metric labels behind flag, (2) recording rule `auth:project:attributed:diff = sum by (effective_project) (increase(api_requests_total[5m])) - sum by (project) (increase(issued_to_project_total[5m]))` so we can monitor bleed, (3) a per-bucket recording `auth:ratebucket:leak:count` keyed by `rate_bucket` and `effective_project` to find noisy buckets.
nora: for PromQL, something like: ```sum by (rate_bucket, effective_project) (increase(api_requests_total{ingress="true"}[10m])) - sum by (rate_bucket, effective_project) (increase(token_issued_total[10m]))``` then filter > 0 to find buckets attributing more than issued.
daniel: console UX: add a "quota-bleed" diagnostic panel on the quota dashboard. show top rate_buckets contributing to the delta for a given project, a small sparkline, and a quick action: "request ingress retag" for oncall to force re-ingress tagging for that bucket. color code: green OK, amber >1% delta, red >5% delta.
jess: cardinality concern: `effective_project` label could explode. mitigate by truncating project ids to 8 chars or only enabling for orgs with >1000 QPS. add a sampling knob: `auth.ingress.attribution_sample_rate` default 5% then auto-escalate to 25% for affected org when delta alert fires.
 yusuf: rollout plan: behind flag `auth.ingress.effective_project=true`. Phase 1: enable labels at 0.5% global canary for 30m, collect deltas. Phase 2: expand to 5% for 2h and wire the recording rules and dashboard but keep UI in annotation mode. Gates: no P50 regression, no increase in prometheus cardinality > 2% (we'll track), and delta per top-10 projects decreases vs baseline.
nora: mitigation if we see bleed post-rollout: (1) flip rate-limiter key to include project id, (2) fallback: sidecar drop affinity after first request (aggressive but safe), (3) temporarily route high-QPS tenants to dedicated workers.
daniel: i'll draft the PR: add ingress tagging hook in gateway, add labels behind flag, recording rule, and grafana panel patch. will include a small prom-cardinality benchmark.
jess: for the alert rule: `auth:project:attributed:diff > max(10, 0.01 * issued)` for 5m with `for: 10m` and silence low-volume projects (<100 tokens/5m). also emit `auth:ingress:tagging_error_total` when tagging fails.
 yusuf: make sure traces include `effective_project` as an attribute when sampled so SRE can follow request flows across multiplexed connections. enable OTEL trace sampling bump for flagged orgs.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: ingress/retagging-canary -> k8s-redwood/us-east-1 (id: deploy-2026-07-08-001) :rocket:
nora: thanks all. once we see the recording rule populate i'll follow up to add the quota-bleed panel to the default dashboard and write a short runbook: "When you see quota-bleed: check rate_bucket heatmap, escalate sampling, consider retag or rate-limiter key change." :thumbsup:
